train_faiss_index_from_embeddings: train a FAISS index from an embeddings file using a specified index type and dimension
train_faiss_index_on_gpu: train a FAISS index on GPU by passing gpu=True to the train_index function
train_index_with_fp16_embeddings: train a FAISS index from float16 embeddings that are automatically cast to float32
move_faiss_index_to_gpu: move a FAISS index to all available GPUs using float16 precision via index_to_gpu
normalize_and_train_faiss_index: L2 normalize embedding data and train a FAISS index factory index on it
